author: Ankit
problem: Read N gift positions on a number line and a length M. Choose a half-open interval [x, x + M) and print the maximum number of gifts inside it.
bug_description: The outer loop uses range(n-1), so with a single gift no window is ever counted and it prints 0.

comments.accurate: Two pointers over the sorted positions: for each left gift, counts the gifts less than M units ahead
comments.wrong_behavior: Slides the left end over every gift except the last, since a window starting there holds just one gift
comments.wrong_location: Window loop verified; check that the positions are sorted before the two pointers
